photographConditions: Two unscaled crops from the same live WebGL camera, at native scroll p=0.76. The detached drawing canvas copied a rectangle of identical size from each rendered frame. Both have full deposition and the same mature morph. Only swept cleaning progress differs, 0 vs 1.

pixelDiagnostic.threshold: Maximum RGB channel change >=4 of 255, at drawing-buffer resolution

sourceHashPolicy: SHA256 refers to the exact staged Git blobs: LF-normalized source text, byte-preserved published data and binary photographs. Served bundle and captures were measured from the same source semantics.
